hebrew:
תּוֹרַת ה' תְּמִימָה, מְשִׁיבַת נָפֶשׁ;

עֵדוּת ה' נֶאֱמָנָה, מַחְכִּימַת פֶּתִי.
translation:
God's instruction is pure, it revives the soul;

God's testimony is faithful, it makes wise the simple.
